basic_info.description: ATLAS LOGISTICS UK LIMITED is a Logistics and Supply Chain company located in London and Birmingham, England, United Kingdom.  From our London office we handle air export and import, Birmingham sea export, sea import, road freight, project cargo and warehousing.   We are IATA / FIATA accredited, Dangerous Goods and Aviation Security compliant along with licences to handle restricted cargo.   Since our inception in 2009 the core philosophy of the company has been customer service.  We provide a bespoke Logistics solution to our clients. We see ourselves as offering the most flexible service with attention to detail of any of our competitors. Hence from the very first stage of quoting through to shipment arrival at destination (import or export) we ensure a very high level of customer service is offered to you and your customers.  From a small parcel to ship or aircraft charter we can accommodate such enquiries.We are Customs Brokers employing fully trained staff to handle all aspects of import and export procedures.We don't just handle the Customs but we can provide impartial guidance through our consultancy programme, working with you and your client to make the whole process of importing and exporting smoother.At our Birmingham location we have access to a 30,000 square feet warehouse to provide pick, pack, short or long-term storage solutions.  Such services are designed to meet our clients requirement with very flexible costing and terms available.Through our overseas agent affiliations and membership of the WCA,the world’s largest and most powerful network of independent freight forwarders, with over 6,032 member offices in 186 countries around the world, we have a Global reach that very few of our competitors can rival.Check out more at www.atlaslogistics.co.uk or call us on +44 (0) 121 783 6564 for more information
